correctness.rationale: The graph P2 square P3 square P3 is Cartesian, 18 vertices and 33 edges. The independent fresh enumerator built every matching by endpoint-disjoint recursive edge selection and verified exactly 90,039 nonempty simplices with complete cardinality vector 33,436,2984,11434,24766,29180,16984,3993,229; reduced Euler characteristic -48. Using the specified edge-toggle order, a separate Python reconstruction found 44,960 matched Hasse pairs and critical cells exactly one 0-cell, 83 5-cells and 35 6-cells. A complete Kahn topological sort eliminated all 90,039 faces across exactly 507,363 signed-free Hasse incidences, confirming acyclicity. Independent signed gradient-path integer recursion, under increasing-edge vertex orientation, rebuilt the 83-by-35 Morse boundary; it had 360 nonzeros with entries absolute value <=2. SymPy exact integer determinant of the specified 35-row square submatrix is -1. Hence the boundary is a primitive full-rank inclusion over Z; GL(Z) basis changes reduce 35 six-cell attaching classes in pi5(wedge^83 S5)=Z^83 to coordinate degree-one maps by Hurewicz, cancelling them and leaving wedge^48 S5. This establishes integral homotopy rather than mod2 rank or Euler alone; the chosen finite certificate was independently reproduced, not inferred from its VERIFY_OK log.
residual_risks: This is one box, not a recursion/classification for arbitrary 3D grids.
The Morse matching is not claimed equivariant, and no representation of the box symmetry group follows.

value.rationale: The 2×3×3 grid is a natural first two-layer three-dimensional thickening of the classical planar 3×n grid topology, not an arbitrary graph slice. Its exact 48-sphere integral homotopy classification supplies a reproducible benchmark for three-dimensional matching complexes. Crucially the unimodular attaching-degree certificate upgrades a mere Betti table and controls torsion and homotopy; the result need not form a general-paper-sized family to be mathematically valuable.
residual_risks: One finite three-dimensional box only; no family recursion.
